about_the_game:
Yukari Niijima's life has become pretty boring lately. She just goes through the same old routine every day: work, ride the subway, sleep, repeat. But recently, something strange has been happening. Every night, Yukari finds herself trapped in weird and creepy nightmares. In these dreams, she's in strange places, solving puzzles, looking for keys, and trying to avoid scary creatures. Sleep used to be her escape, but now it's more like a battleground where Yukari fights to keep her sanity.

Features:
• Various challenges and puzzles.
• Depressive/melancholic atmosphere.
• 4 hours of gameplay.
• A multitude of mini-games.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows 8.1 (32bit/64bit)
  • Processor: Intel N4100 (or similar) or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 display is recommended at x2 resolution but is not required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10 (32bit/64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 display is recommended at x2 resolution but is not required

short_description: Yukari Niijima, a girl leading a mundane life, finds herself plagued by nightly nightmares filled with puzzles, keys, and eerie creatures, disrupting her usual routine of work and subway rides.
